summary: Form_Load handler that initialises the DAO database connection (dbsOrders), populates the product cmbProducts list, and seeds txtOrderId with the next sequential id from a DAO query. Controls have already been instantiated by the VB6 runtime before this fires — relying on that ordering is a portability trap because the C# WinForms Load event has different lifecycle semantics.

invariants.claim: dbsOrders is opened and stored as a form-level field by the end of this handler. Subsequent button handlers assume it is non-null.
cmbProducts has at least one row after this handler returns; the first product is selected (ListIndex = 0).

on_error_handlers.policy: Catches DAO 3024 (database file not found). The handler shows a fatal-error MsgBox and unloads the form. Other Err.Number values escape — VB6 default error dialog.
on_error_handlers.translation_hint: C# 10: try { ... } catch (FileNotFoundException) { ShowFatal(); Close(); }. Other exceptions propagate.

event_handler_contracts.fires_when: The VB6 runtime invokes Form_Load AFTER the form's window handle is created and AFTER every control's CreateInstance has run — but BEFORE the form becomes visible.
event_handler_contracts.contract: Controls (cmbProducts, txtOrderId, lblStatus) are guaranteed to be addressable; their .Text / .List values may already carry designer-set defaults. Promises: dbsOrders open, cmbProducts populated, txtOrderId pre-filled. Does NOT promise the form is visible yet.
event_handler_contracts.target_paradigm_hint: WinForms: override OnLoad(EventArgs) — runs after handle creation, before Shown. Blazor: OnInitializedAsync — different semantics; controls don't yet have DOM, so cmbProducts population should happen there but layout-dependent reads should move to OnAfterRenderAsync.

default_property_usages.expansion: DAO Recordset bang-notation reads the .Value of the named Field. In C# DAO/Jet stays as `rs.Fields["ProductName"].Value` or migrates to EF Core property access.
default_property_usages.translation_hint: EF Core 10: `var name = product.ProductName;` after mapping the recordset to a typed entity. Direct DAO retained only if the customer requires JET MDB compatibility.

side_effects.description: Opens a DAO Database against the application-local .mdb file (path is hard-coded relative to App.Path).

edge_cases.description: The DAO query for the next order id returns Null (no rows yet). The handler defaults txtOrderId to '1001'.

open_questions.question: Should the database connection move to a singleton service in the .NET 10 port instead of being held on the form, or is per-form lifetime acceptable?
